_comment: Synthetic fixture, documented shape (fix round 3 fold-in). tailnet's own public port (8443) already proxies correctly to tailnet's own local target (8788) -- check 3 (stale target) must not fire -- but the same mapping is marked AllowFunnel. 8443 is one of the three ports Tailscale Funnel itself is restricted to, so this is a real, reachable misconfiguration: it would publish the one raisable listener to the open internet while TENKA believes it is tailnet-only.
